description: An instrumented Compose test. android-ui-test-reviewer must fire. This fixture used to assert arch-reviewer and refactor-advisor did NOT — production-only reviewers, tests left to the test reviewers. That is no longer the split: the comment doctrine gives test files no exemption (only refactor-advisor applies the falsifiability test, and the last real run put 745 comment lines in tests that nothing reviewed), and arch-reviewer's own rules include fake and contract-test placement. Both now fire on a test file. api-reviewer and android-presentation-reviewer still must not. Routing is path-only, so the files are created empty.
